items.proposed: agreed coding stands: has_eligible_candidate false, no_pharmacological_candidate
items.reason: The registered intervention is a "[DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] CBMed Drug Screening Plattform", and the tumour board's "personalized treatment recommendation" names no drugs. Nothing says the drugs are approved or licensed, so under D30-R8 this is not an unspecified_approved_panel.

note: The record is Phase NA, so it fails S3 by [CODE] anyway. Under D30-R8 it is listed separately as a drug-screen trial with no named or approved drugs. any_molecular_selection is true from the MGMT-unmethylated entry requirement, but this does not affect the analysis because the trial is excluded. D31-B12 does not apply: the record does not say the screened drugs are clinically approved. MGMT-unmethylated is a required value, so eligibility under D31-A8.
